reviews.author: Rajesh Patel
reviews.text: Excellent sofa making workshop in Dindoli! Got our 7-seater L-shaped sofa customized with 40D Sleepwell foam and premium velvet fabric. Finishing is top notch and owner guided us honestly with fabric rates.

reviews.author: Sanjay Sharma
reviews.text: Very polite craftsman and honest rates. Repaired our sagged 5-seater sofa cushions within 2 days with high resilience foam. Feels like a brand new sofa now.

reviews.author: Pratik Desai
reviews.text: Ordered a pull-out hydraulic sofa bed for our guest bedroom. The mechanism is very sturdy, smooth to operate and wood quality is genuine. Highly recommend Shree Balaji Sofa.

reviews.author: Neha Mehta
reviews.text: Custom made our fluted dining chairs and master bedroom headboard wall paneling. Perfect stitching, delivered right on the promised date.

reviews.author: Vikram Solanki
reviews.text: Best residential furniture workshop in Surat for customized sofa designs. They show you the wooden frame and foam before stitching the fabric. 100% transparent.
